name: graphicsstyles
title: Asset Styles
description: s6-modular: the drawing style per category (Tiles, Map Objects, Items, Monsters, NPCs, Characters, Mounts, Effects), from the installed drawing modules (Modern 2d-7x, Retro 2d-5x, 3D 3d-v1): saved per profile and applied live. The modules themselves are C# (TK.Modular.Draw).
